related.title: PCM 類比AI：ADC量化與漂移誤差預算
related.titleEn: PCM analog AI: ADC quantization and drift budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：單位一致、疊加檢查完成、負權重編碼另列，類比核心未被當成完整推論系統。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Units and superposition pass, signed encoding is explicit, and the analog core is not the whole inference system.
related.difference: 建立ADC半LSB與漂移的最壞誤差界，說明增加ADC位元不能消除元件漂移。
related.differenceEn: Budget half-LSB and drift errors, showing why more ADC bits do not remove device drift.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 理想欄電流I=ΣGiVi；以電導編碼非負權重，負值需差動或其他編碼。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學G1=20 μS、G2=40 μS，V1=0.1 V、V2=0.2 V，假設線阻為零。 I=20×0.1+40×0.2=10 μA；μS×V=μA。此線性模型不含飽和及非線性。
教學均勻ADC步距Δ=FS/2^b，最近捨入界Δ/2；已知最壞偏差可保守相加。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 FS=1 V、b=8，類比漂移界1 mV；忽略失調、熱雜訊與飽和。 總界=1000/(2×2^8)+1=2.953125 mV。這是保守界，不是標準差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal column current I=ΣGiVi; conductance encodes nonnegative weights, with differential or other coding needed for signs. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching G1=20 μS, G2=40 μS, V1=0.1 V, V2=0.2 V, with zero wire resistance. I=20×0.1+40×0.2=10 μA;μS×V=μA, excluding saturation and nonlinearity.

Teaching uniform ADC spacing is FS/2^b, with nearest-rounding boundΔ/2; bounded worst-case biases add conservatively. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. FS=1 V, b=8, analog drift bound1 mV; ignore offset, thermal noise and saturation. Total bound=1000/(2×2^8)+1=2.953125 mV, a worst-case bound rather than standard deviation.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GQA 推論部署：KV 頭分組與快取節省
related.titleEn: Deploying GQA: KV-head grouping and cache savings
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：單位一致、疊加檢查完成、負權重編碼另列，類比核心未被當成完整推論系統。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Units and superposition pass, signed encoding is explicit, and the analog core is not the whole inference system.
related.difference: 明確區分query頭與KV頭，計算分組後快取，避免只改配置而不改模型。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish query heads from KV heads and calculate cache savings without treating configuration changes as model conversion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 理想欄電流I=ΣGiVi；以電導編碼非負權重，負值需差動或其他編碼。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學G1=20 μS、G2=40 μS，V1=0.1 V、V2=0.2 V，假設線阻為零。 I=20×0.1+40×0.2=10 μA；μS×V=μA。此線性模型不含飽和及非線性。
KV容量與Hkv成正比，query頭數不直接決定KV儲存；權重及注意力映射必須相容。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 L32、query頭32、D128、T4096、FP16=2 bytes；先用Hkv32。 快取容量KV=2×32×32×128×4096×2/2^30=2 GiB。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal column current I=ΣGiVi; conductance encodes nonnegative weights, with differential or other coding needed for signs. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching G1=20 μS, G2=40 μS, V1=0.1 V, V2=0.2 V, with zero wire resistance. I=20×0.1+40×0.2=10 μA;μS×V=μA, excluding saturation and nonlinearity.

KV storage scales with Hkv, not directly with query heads; weights and attention mapping must remain compatible. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. L32, 32 query heads, D128, T4096, FP16 two bytes; baselineHkv32. KV=2×32×32×128×4096×2/2^30=2 GiB.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
